meta.name: Binary · full GV distance
meta.regime: Binary random linear codes; full Gilbert–Varshamov distance; maximum over rates
meta.rules: Use random binary linear codes of rate R=k/n, error weight n H₂⁻¹(1−R), and maximize the exponent over 0≤R≤1. The parameter n is code length. Keep half-distance and fixed-rate bounds separate. Historical coefficients are rounded as in their cited sources; they are upper bounds, not claimed optimal values.
